name: Techqueria
notes: Affinity: other; org: Techqueria; join: request-form; scope: tech-with-security-channel. Latinx professionals in tech (allies also welcome); Slack access is free but gated behind a membership application (collects professional/demographic info) at techqueria.org/join, not an open invite link. Members log in at techqueria.slack.com. Not a dedicated security community but broad tech community with security-adjacent members.

name: VetSec (Veterans in Security)
notes: Affinity: veterans; org: VetSec; join: request-form; scope: security. Site states 'Your membership invite will come from Slack, our community platform. Application to any of our programs occurs within Slack.' No public discord.gg/slack-invite link visible; applicants apply via the Join Us page and receive a Slack invite.

name: Blacks In Cybersecurity (BIC)
notes: Affinity: bipoc; org: Blacks In Cybersecurity; join: request-form; scope: security. The blacksincyberconf.com/online-community page (missed by the first pass) states: 'Please fill out this form for our online community application' — an open Google Form anyone can submit, with an alternative path of having an existing member vouch. Platform (Discord/Slack) not disclosed since it migrates over time.

name: elhacker.NET Foro
notes: Affinity: non-english; org: elhacker.net; join: free-signup; scope: security. Long-running Spanish-language hacking/security forum, 331k+ registered users, open free registration. No Discord server visible on the homepage; they instead run Telegram (t.me/elhackerdotnet), Mastodon (infosec.exchange/@elhackernet) and a Facebook group, but Telegram is out of scope per instructions.

name: Inforge Forum
notes: Affinity: non-english; org: Inforge.net; join: free-signup; scope: security. Largest Italian tech forum community (founded 2007) with a dedicated Sicurezza Informatica (cybersecurity/ethical hacking) section; registration is free and not required to browse most content. Also has a Telegram channel (t.me/inforge) which is out of scope.

name: CTF-BR
notes: Affinity: non-english; org: CTF-BR; join: open-link; scope: security. CTF-BR is a Brazilian community promoting CTF competitions; their own site publishes this open Discord invite for anyone interested in Brazilian CTF/security. Verify the invite is still live before publishing since it dates to a 2020 post.

name: Kanxue (看雪) Security Forum
notes: Affinity: non-english; org: bbs.kanxue.com; join: free-signup; scope: security. Major Chinese reverse-engineering / software security forum founded 2000, sections for reverse engineering, Android/iOS security, CTF, etc. Site blocked direct WebFetch (403), so registration flow and any QQ-group link could not be visually confirmed — based on search-result description only.

name: Hackplayers Foro
notes: Affinity: non-english; org: Hackplayers; join: free-signup; scope: security. Spanish-language hacking/security research community founded 2009 in Madrid; runs its own forum plus a Telegram channel (t.me/hackplayers, out of scope). Could not directly WebFetch the forum (DNS resolution failed from this environment) so the join flow is unverified first-hand.
